value.title: SQL Injection Detection & Differential Verification Methodology
value.content: {"id": "portswigger_sqli", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "sqli", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: SQL Injection (SQLi)", "name": "SQL Injection Detection & Differential Verification Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-89", "owasp_category": "A03:2021 - Injection", "signals": ["sql_syntax_error", "database_error_reflection", "numeric_parameter_variation", "boolean_differential_response", "time_delay_execution", "order_by_boundary"], "verification_strategy": "Conduct safe boolean differential probing (e.g. AND 1=1 vs AND 1=2), test ORDER BY column position boundaries to determine column projection size without extracting user data, and verify UNION NULL column compatibility safely.", "evidence_requirements": ["response_delta_length", "status_code_invariance", "syntax_error_snippet", "null_column_count_proof"], "tools": [{"tool": "SQLiSkill", "cmd": "run_sqli_skill(url, param, objective='version')", "desc": "Autonomous state machine: DETECT -> CLASSIFY -> COUNT_COLS -> VERIFY"}, {"tool": "sqlmap (safe audit)", "cmd": "sqlmap -u 'https://example.com/item?id=1' --batch --banner --level=2 --risk=1", "desc": "Differential SQLi audit engine verifying injection points"}, {"tool": "SmartPoC (SQLi)", "cmd": "SmartPoC.execute_and_verify(target, param, vuln_type='sqli')", "desc": "Zero-weaponized boolean & error reflection validator"}], "remediation": "Mandate parameterized queries and prepared statements (e.g., PreparedStatement in Java, PDO with emulation turned off in PHP). Never concatenate untrusted parameters into SQL queries.", "description": "PortSwigger curriculum for SQL Injection covers in-band UNION attacks, error-based exploitation, blind boolean inference, blind time delays, and out-of-band application interactions (DNS/HTTP via Collaborator)."}
